protectedApprovals.nextCommand: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_RUN_ID) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA)) { throw 'Release run and source SHA are required' }; $protection=gh api repos/Syntax-Circus/cmsify/environments/release | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Release environment protection query failed' }; $reviewers=@($protection.protection_rules | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'required_reviewers' }); if ($reviewers.Count -eq 0) { throw 'Release environment has no required reviewers' }; $approvals=gh api repos/Syntax-Circus/cmsify/actions/runs/$env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_RUN_ID/approvals | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Release approval query failed' }; $approved=@($approvals | Where-Object { $_.state -eq 'approved' -and @($_.environments | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'release' }).Count -gt 0 }); if ($approved.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No approved release-environment evidence' }; $deployments=@(gh api "repos/Syntax-Circus/cmsify/deployments?environment=release&sha=$env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" | ConvertFrom-Json); if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Release deployment query failed' }; if ($deployments.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No immutable deployment evidence' }; foreach ($deployment in $deployments) { $statuses=@(gh api repos/Syntax-Circus/cmsify/deployments/$($deployment.id)/statuses | ConvertFrom-Json); if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Release deployment-status query failed' }; $latest=$statuses | Sort-Object created_at -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $latest -or $latest.state -ne 'success') { throw 'Latest release deployment status is not successful' } }

artifactAttestation.nextCommand: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_CHECKSUMS_PATH) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_WORKFLOW_IDENTITY) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA)) { throw 'Checksums path, workflow identity, and source SHA are required' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:CMSIFY_CHECKSUMS_PATH -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'SHA256SUMS file is missing' }; $root=Split-Path -Parent (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $env:CMSIFY_CHECKSUMS_PATH); $seen=[Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal); $subjects=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $env:CMSIFY_CHECKSUMS_PATH | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -notmatch '^[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}\s+\*?([^\/].*)$') { throw 'Invalid SHA256SUMS entry' }; $subject=$Matches[1]; if ([IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($subject) -or $subject -match '(^|[\/])\.\.([\/]|$)' -or -not $seen.Add($subject)) { throw 'SHA256SUMS subject is rooted, traverses, or duplicates' }; $path=Join-Path $root $subject; $relative=[IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($root, [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($path)); if ($relative -match '(^|[\/])\.\.([\/]|$)' -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'SHA256SUMS subject is outside candidate root or missing' }; [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($path) }); if ($subjects.Count -eq 0) { throw 'SHA256SUMS contains no subjects' }; foreach ($subject in $subjects) { gh attestation verify $subject --repo Syntax-Circus/cmsify --signer-workflow $env:CMSIFY_WORKFLOW_IDENTITY --source-digest $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "Attestation verification failed for $subject" } }

registrySigning.nextCommand: cosign verify --certificate-identity $env:CMSIFY_WORKFLOW_IDENTITY --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com docker.io/syntaxcircus/cmsify-api@$env:CMSIFY_API_DIGEST; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'API signature verification failed' }; cosign verify --certificate-identity $env:CMSIFY_WORKFLOW_IDENTITY --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com docker.io/syntaxcircus/cmsify-admin@$env:CMSIFY_ADMIN_DIGEST; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Admin signature verification failed' }

immutableOciPromotion.nextCommand: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_VERSION) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_API_DIGEST) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_ADMIN_DIGEST)) { throw 'Release version and both immutable digests are required' }; $apiDescriptor=oras manifest fetch --descriptor docker.io/syntaxcircus/cmsify-api:$env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_VERSION; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'API descriptor fetch failed' }; $api=($apiDescriptor | ConvertFrom-Json).digest; if ($api -notmatch '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') { throw 'API descriptor digest is invalid' }; if ($api -ne $env:CMSIFY_API_DIGEST) { throw 'API digest mismatch' }; $adminDescriptor=oras manifest fetch --descriptor docker.io/syntaxcircus/cmsify-admin:$env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_VERSION; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Admin descriptor fetch failed' }; $admin=($adminDescriptor | ConvertFrom-Json).digest; if ($admin -notmatch '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$') { throw 'Admin descriptor digest is invalid' }; if ($admin -ne $env:CMSIFY_ADMIN_DIGEST) { throw 'Admin digest mismatch' }

hostedSmokeSoak.reason: No hosted smoke or soak evidence.
hostedSmokeSoak.nextCommand: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_RUN_ID) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_SMOKE_JOB_ID) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_UPGRADE_ROLLBACK_JOB_ID) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_SOAK_EVIDENCE_PATH)) { throw 'Run, source SHA, job, and soak evidence inputs are required' }; gh run view $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_RUN_ID --repo Syntax-Circus/cmsify --job $env:CMSIFY_SMOKE_JOB_ID --log --exit-status; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Smoke job failed' }; gh run view $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_RUN_ID --repo Syntax-Circus/cmsify --job $env:CMSIFY_UPGRADE_ROLLBACK_JOB_ID --log --exit-status; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Upgrade rollback job failed' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:CMSIFY_SOAK_EVIDENCE_PATH -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Soak evidence is missing' }; $soak=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $env:CMSIFY_SOAK_EVIDENCE_PATH | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($soak.schema -ne 'cmsify.hosted-soak-evidence.v1' -or $soak.releaseRunId -ne $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_RUN_ID -or $soak.sourceSha -ne $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA -or $soak.smokeJobId -ne $env:CMSIFY_SMOKE_JOB_ID -or $soak.upgradeRollbackJobId -ne $env:CMSIFY_UPGRADE_ROLLBACK_JOB_ID -or -not $soak.smokePassed -or -not $soak.upgradeRollbackPassed -or -not $soak.passed) { throw 'Soak evidence identity or status is invalid' }; try { $started=[datetime]::Parse($soak.startedAtUtc, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind); $completed=[datetime]::Parse($soak.completedAtUtc, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture, [Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::RoundtripKind) } catch { throw 'Soak evidence timestamps are invalid' }; if ($started.Kind -ne [DateTimeKind]::Utc -or $completed.Kind -ne [DateTimeKind]::Utc -or $completed -le $started -or ($completed - $started).TotalMinutes -lt 60) { throw 'Required 60-minute soak evidence is invalid' }

finalRelease.reason: Final release is not authorized or certified.
finalRelease.nextCommand: if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_TAG) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA)) { throw 'Release tag and source SHA are required' }; $release=gh release view $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_TAG --repo Syntax-Circus/cmsify --json tagName,targetCommitish,isDraft,publishedAt,url | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Release query failed' }; if ($release.isDraft -or -not $release.publishedAt) { throw 'Release is draft or unpublished' }; if ($release.tagName -ne $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_TAG) { throw 'Release tag mismatch' }; if ($release.targetCommitish -ne $env:CMSIFY_RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA) { throw 'Release target mismatch' }
